system.description:
Once per round, when you hit a creature with a melee attack, let the momentum carry through — make one extra melee attack. Against the creature you just hit it is rolled with Disadvantage; against a different creature within your reach it is a normal roll. The extra attack cannot trigger Flowing Strikes again.

Available to: Fighters, Barbarians, Knights, Paladins, Magi, Bards, Rangers, Archers, Gunslingers, Swashbucklers, Rogues, Assassins, and Monks.

activities.name: Against the same creature
activities.text: Once per round, after hitting a creature with a melee attack. The extra attack cannot trigger Flowing Strikes again.

activities.name: Against a different creature
activities.text: Once per round, after hitting a creature with a melee attack. The extra attack cannot trigger Flowing Strikes again. A different creature within your reach.
